note: Simple Block provides title/content custom blocks stored as CONFIG entities (simple_block, config_prefix simple_block; config name simple_block.simple_block.<id>) with keys id, title, content (text_format value+format). Each entity is exposed as a derived block plugin simple_block:<id> that renders processed_text with global token replacement; a field formatter simple_block_rendered_entity renders a referenced simple block. Admin UI at /admin/structure/block/simple-block (route entity.simple_block.collection). Permissions: update/clone/delete simple blocks (add/list need administer blocks). Depends block+filter. Medium/hard cases create namespaced simple_block config entities (sb_*) and inspect/verify them and their block derivative.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal contrib module simple_block store its blocks, and how does that differ from core's Block Content (block_content)? What fields does each simple block hold?
evals.expected_output: simple_block stores each block as a config entity (simple_block, config name simple_block.simple_block.<id>) rather than a content entity like core's block_content. Each holds an id (machine name), a title, and formatted content (a text_format value + filter format), so it can be exported and deployed with configuration management.

evals.prompt: Once I create a simple_block called 'promo', what block plugin id do I place in a region, and are tokens supported in its content?
evals.expected_output: The block is exposed as the derived block plugin simple_block:promo (the plugin id is simple_block, derived per entity). Its content is rendered as processed_text with global tokens replaced via \Drupal::token()->replace() (e.g. [site:name]).

evals.prompt: Where in the Drupal admin do I create and manage simple_block blocks, and what permission is needed to add one?
evals.expected_output: Manage them at /admin/structure/block/simple-block (route entity.simple_block.collection), with Add/Edit/Clone/Delete forms. Adding and listing require core's 'administer blocks' permission; the module's own permissions only gate update/clone/delete of existing blocks.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, a simple_block config entity has been created. Inspect the live configuration and give its machine id and title.
evals.expected_output: The block is id sb_known (config simple_block.simple_block.sb_known) with title 'SB Known Title'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a simple_block with machine id sb_known2. Inspect the live site and give the exact block plugin id you would use to place it in a region.
evals.expected_output: The block plugin id is simple_block:sb_known2 (the simple_block plugin derived for the sb_known2 entity).

evals.expected_output: Create the simple_block entity sb_hero and save it (postSave clears the block plugin cache). Verify checks that the block plugin manager has the derived definition simple_block:sb_hero.
